classification.basis: The custom guest log proves ACPI platform discovery, VMBus 5.3 enumeration, AF_VSOCK registration, and hv_sock driver registration. No Hyper-V storage device or ext4 distribution root was detected, so B3 is not proved. mini_init and host-side mini_init messaging became active out of checkpoint order, but command dispatch did not complete.

firstGuestUserspaceFailure: mini_init could not mount /sys/fs/cgroup: UtilMkdir returned errno 1 (EPERM); CONFIG_CGROUPS is disabled.
fatalObservedFailure: The host sent a GNS request, the GNS socket closed before the expected result, and CreateInstance ended with 0x80072746 (WSAECONNRESET). wsl.exe reported mirrored networking unsupported, NAT configuration failure, fallback to networkingMode None, and CreateVm/ConfigureNetworking/E_UNEXPECTED.
secondaryObservations: The console errors remain: /dev/hvc1 and /dev/console are absent, but they did not prevent VMBus, hv_sock, or mini_init host messaging.
The page_reporting sysfs parameter is absent because CONFIG_PAGE_REPORTING and CONFIG_HYPERV_BALLOON remain disabled; this was logged but was not the terminal error.
CONFIG_NET_NS is disabled while the preserved host .wslconfig requests mirrored networking; the exact minimal GNS/network-namespace closure requires review before another candidate.
CONFIG_HYPERV_STORAGE is disabled and no storvsc disk appeared, so the distribution root could not reach B3.
decision: Retain the ACPI plus VSOCK/Hyper-V VSOCK bundle provisionally: it directly advanced B1 to B2 and restored host-channel messaging. Before another boot, review the minimal stock-control-plane cgroup/GNS/network-namespace closure versus moving to the selected reduced-init track. Do not infer a need for the broad Stage 1 networking or storage configuration, and do not add the console bundle solely for observability. A new explicit decision is required for any next custom-kernel boot.
